notes: #95 This month. iPhone: runtime captures (xcrun simctl io screenshot --display=primary) of a Debug build on the persistent iPhone Duo, launched with -ScreenshotFixture -ScreenshotWindow month|daily -dismissedPrivateContribTip YES (Sample board data; the fixture refreshes twice, so both Windows show movement). Mac: the scripts/build-flow-capture.py fixture host, launched with -CaptureWindow month|daily -CaptureSnapshot <file> (the host writes its own window's contents; this shell has no Screen Recording permission). The share story is a render, not runtime capture: BoardShareTests.thisMonthStoryFromTheSampleBoard renders the real BoardShareRenderer from AppModel.boardToShare() on the Sample board, on a disposable iPhone Duo via scripts/ios_check.py ios. No before captures: the three-segment baseline was not recaptured. All captured on 2026-11-10 (Day 10 of 30).
